rules: No previous settlement U or physical product is modified.
Credit the 150 million kg embedded construction plant once; retain the existing ground utility inventory and add only industrial capacity beyond its 2 GW allocation.
Prices are 2026-real scenario inputs; one 15-year inflation multiplication gives 2041 dollars. All later spending is at flat 2041 prices.
Supplier capital, operating costs and renewal are paid in the owner budget; diagnostic internal tariffs are never added to that budget.

The material campaign excludes civil installation and commissioning labour within settlements, passenger transport, settlement civic, food-growing and household operations during phased occupation, finance, planetary terraforming, and unqualified source/site losses.
